title: Yui — Chapter 1: Like
subtitle: Usne teri purani photo like ki…

lines: Notification tab aaya jab tum bistar pe leta tha, aadha soya, social media scroll karte hue.
Kisi ne teri ek purani photo like ki thi.
Naya post nahi. Kal wala nahi. Kareeb teen mahine purani photo.
Jigyasa hui, tumne notification pe tap kiya.
Account ek ladki ka tha — naam Yui.
Profile saaf aur chupke se attractive — university student, brands ke liye part-time freelance model.
Skincare. Lifestyle. Kabhi-kabhi lingerie. Pro nahi, lekin brands baar-baar bulate rahe.
Uske paas wo look tha jisse jo bhi wo pakadti, wo chahne layak lagne lagta.
Wo rahi. Yui.
Sirf profile picture se tum scroll rok baitha.
Zyadatar log ignore kar dete. Tumne nahi kiya.
Tumne profile kholi. Paanch minute baad bhi scroll kar raha tha.
Phir dhyan aaya — usne tera ek aur post like kiya tha. Aur purana. Lagbhag saal bhar pehle ka.
Tumne screen dekha. Halki si muskaan. Faisla kiya — message karna hai.
Chat window khuli.
Shuruaat kaise karoge?

choices.label: Likes ke liye thanks. Socha nahi tha koi profile itni gehrai mein jayega.
Lagta hai tumne sabse purani photo like karne ka record tod diya 😏
Freelance modeling? Sach mein bahut hot hai.
(Message se pehle uski ek photo like karo.)

lines: Oh! Tumne notice kar liya 🙈

…Tumne waqai mera bio dekha 😌

Koi message nahi. Bas… wo. Smooth. Mystery. Samajh gayi.
Ab mujhe *sach mein* jaanna hai tum kaun hai.

Jo bhi tumne kaha, kaam kar gaya. Typing dots aaye — ruke — phir aaye.
Jaise wo shabdon ko soch-samajh kar chun rahi ho.
Oke sach bataun — main usually aisa nahi karti 😅
Anjaan ki saal bhar purani photo like karna bilkul mera style nahi.
Lekin raat ho chuki hai, shehar shaant hai, aur tujhmein kuch aisa tha ki sach mein hi bolna chaha.
To… khush hai ki maine kiya? 💕

Safed camisole, patli strap, soft fit, neckline itni neeche ki chhaati ka curve dikhe. Figure full tha aur top chhipane ki koshish nahi karta — cleavage light pakad rahi thi, upar ki body frame le leti thi isse pehle ki nazar aur kuch pe jaaye.
Mid-thigh mini skirt. Ek haath aaram se side mein, thuddhi thodi neeche, lens ke paar nazar — jaise asar pata ho aur chhodne ka faisla kar liya ho.
